scope: BOT-DIVERSITY5.2.1 bounded technical timing-window spike; same outcome masks. Outcome-mask diversity is a separate experiment.
method: Each single edge is shifted with every other input fixed. Valid requires same completed and hit masks, full Lagger finish, no rejected input, same negative effects. Windows describe sampled feasible points, not a certified continuous interval. Joint seeds0..19 sample the measured valid points; failed seeds are reported, with at most two explicit measured-point repairs. Master must remain100% with Constant; lower-level Constant actual outcomes are reported.
